title: Thermal Activation of Divergent Distillable Entanglement under Non-Abelian Strong Symmetry
summary: Heating usually destroys quantum entanglement. We show that thermalization constrained to a non-Abelian strong-symmetry sector can instead generate a distillable resource that diverges with system size. In an exactly solvable local dimer chain, entanglement across an equal bipartition is exactly zero at $T=0$, whereas every fixed $T>0$ yields $E_D=\frac12\log_2 N+C(T)+o(1)$. Measurements of the two half-chain representation labels convert thermally populated non-Abelian sectors into standard ebits.
